# Business Data Dictionary

This data dictionary defines the key procurement concepts and fields used throughout the **CNMA Approval** portal. These fields map directly to information imported from S/4HANA ERP records.

---

## 📦 Purchase Requisitions (PR)
A **Purchase Requisition** is an internal request created by an employee or department to authorize the purchase of goods or services.

### Header Fields
*   **Requisition Number**: Unique 10-digit identification number generated by the ERP.
*   **Document Type**: Code specifying the requisition type (e.g., standard, service, framework).
*   **Total Net Amount**: Total estimated value of the requisition converted to local currency (VND).
*   **Document Currency**: The original currency in which the requisition was created (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD).
*   **Total Document Value**: Total net value in the original currency.
*   **Requester Name**: Name of the employee who submitted the requisition.
*   **Department**: Originating department requesting the procurement.
*   **Created On**: Date and time the requisition was registered.
*   **Priority**: Criticality indicator (Low, Medium, High, Very High) determining review urgency.

### Line Item Fields
*   **Item Number**: Sequential line number (e.g., 10, 20, 30).
*   **Material Description**: Name and details of the goods or services requested.
*   **Quantity**: Number of units requested.
*   **Unit of Measure**: Standard measurement unit (e.g., PC for pieces, HUR for hours, activity unit).
*   **Net Price**: Unit price of the item in original currency.
*   **Net Value**: Total calculated value of the line item (Quantity x Net Price).
*   **Material Group**: Category classification for the material (e.g., IT Hardware, Office Supplies).

---

## 💼 Purchase Orders (PO)
A **Purchase Order** is a legally binding contract sent to a supplier, committing to purchase items under specific prices, terms, and delivery schedules.

### Header Fields
*   **Order Number**: Unique 10-digit identification number representing the contract.
*   **Supplier / Vendor**: The company supplying the goods or services.
*   **Company Code**: The legal entity code of the purchasing enterprise.
*   **Purchasing Organization**: The procurement department responsible for negotiating terms.
*   **Payment Terms**: Agreed terms outlining when payment is due (e.g., Net 30 days).
*   **Order Value**: The total contractual value of the purchase order in original currency.
*   **Order Value (VND)**: The total order value converted to local currency (VND).

### Line Item Fields
*   **Material Number / Description**: Catalog ID and name of the material being purchased.
*   **Plant**: The business location where the goods should be delivered.
*   **Storage Location**: Internal warehouse area designated for receipt.
*   **Delivery Date**: Expected arrival date for the line item.

### Account Assignment Details
*   **G/L Account**: General Ledger chart of accounts code for financial reporting.
*   **Cost Center**: The department budget to which the expense is charged.
*   **Profit Center**: The business unit generating the budget allocation.
